best_human.optimality: feasible historical upper-bound witness; no optimality claim

best_public.evidence_state: paper reports the 51-step value rounded upward; our rational transcription reproduces a slightly lower exact value
best_public.optimality: published upper bound for the limiting constant; not an optimality proof
best_public.origin_type: unknown unless attribution is stated in source/provenance

best_reproduced.provenance: task-local rational transcription of the 51 printed decimal heights in Haugland (2016)
best_reproduced.evidence_state: exact 51-lag-pair correlation computed; piecewise linearity certifies all real shifts

baseline_seed.evidence_state: valid exact-mass initial point; not a published result

source_notes: The 51 printed decimals sum to 25.5, so the corresponding 51 equal bins have exact integral (2/51)*25.5=1; no correction was applied.
The paper states a rounded-up value of 0.3809268534330870. Exact arithmetic on the decimal-rational transcription gives 0.38092685343308696.
The paper also discusses a 19-step construction with a smaller value; it does not match this fixed 51-step configuration.
survey_scope_note: Best public means the strongest same-parameter result in the cited checked sources. This is not a claim that every public source has been surveyed. Unmatched parameters are listed separately.
frozen_human_baseline_type: published human witness or explicit construction formula
